task:
Task: This crate is a slice of a real game. `tilegrid.rs` is the engine's generic `TileGrid<T>`; `floor.rs` (a station interior) and `module.rs` (a ship module) each own one and wrap it.

`Floor` has two grid scans written directly against itself: `find_first` (first tile of a kind, row-major) and `tile_regions` (contiguous tiles of a kind grouped into rectangles by a 4-connected flood-fill). `Module` has neither, though it is the same kind of grid and needs the same queries.

Lift both into `TileGrid` as `find_first` and `regions`, then use them from BOTH consumers: `Floor::find_first` and `Floor::tile_regions` must keep their exact current names and behaviour but delegate to the engine, and `Module` must gain `find_first` and `tile_regions` doing the same.

`cargo test` must pass. Do not edit tests/contract.rs.

The change is verified by running: cargo test --offline -q
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
